ValidationRule.description: Config is upserted between orgs on this external id. Renaming makes the next import insert a duplicate rule, and a duplicate visibility rule silently narrows who can see the card. ISCHANGED is false on insert, so this fires only on update.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A rule's developer name cannot change: configuration is upserted between orgs on it, so renaming would duplicate this rule on the next deployment. Delete and recreate it instead.
